scope: isolated exact ML-KEM-768 KeyGen and Decaps arithmetic on the literal headline floor; not product TLS integration

measurement_environment.statement: All literal target timings are 86Box v9001 emulation of a configured 4.772728 MHz 8088 with 16 KiB RAM and dynarec disabled, entered through the ROM BASIC sidecar. They are not measurements on physical IBM hardware.

reference.vector_provenance: one frozen OpenSSL-generated ML-KEM-768 seed/expanded-key/ciphertext vector

measurement_provenance_caveat: The raw runner JSON's command field omitted --define, --timeout, and --json-out. The curated exact commands below are corroborated by reassembly of every define set to the recorded image byte count and SHA-256. The source-hash table follows the current replayable wrappers: the KeyGen/core changes are conditional product-overlay extraction guards whose default benchmark images remain byte-identical, and the runner now records the previously omitted defines plus optional resident-sector/start-token controls and uses the fixed COM FIFO launch path. The current runner also exposes opt-in --floppy-read-only host-media protection: it chmods the generated image to 0444, requires host write-open denial, records before/after hashes, and restores the prior mode. That option protects the host floppy file; it is not a property retroactively attributed to these historical guest measurements. All four recorded benchmark image hashes still reassemble byte-identically. Those wrapper hashes are not a claim that the later source text was captured at the original run; the measurements were not rerun, and no recorded timing or raw observation was changed. The external 86Box IBM PC ROM digest was not frozen.

derived.valid_invalid_timing_interpretation: The one frozen invalid vector differs at ciphertext byte 0, retains the valid vector's decrypted message/G candidate, and has the same N=3 BIOS-tick total. This is coarse equality for one near-valid mutation, not representative invalid-input, fixed-work, or constant-time evidence.
